question: Is the attainment of the eight siddhis identified as the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight siddhis are named as attainments.
Attainment of these siddhis is equated with the root Kaula.
The goddess is addressed as fair-faced.
inference: Therefore, obtaining the eight siddhis constitutes the essential realization of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact list of the eight siddhis is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula.
